status_legend.reported_by_source: Value taken from a named data feed, statement or filing as the report states it. Not independently re-fetched in this pass.
status_legend.recomputed_consistent: Arithmetic re-checked from values stated in the reports; matches within rounding.
status_legend.derived_unverified: Inference or calculation that depends on inputs the reports do not directly verify.
status_legend.company_press_claim: From a company press release, conference listing or reprint. Not independently verified.
status_legend.third_party_unverified: From an aggregator, vendor-sponsored forecast or undated web source.
status_legend.forward_looking: Expectation, guidance or scheduled future event.
status_legend.conflicting: Contradicted by another value or report in this evidence set. See cross_report_conflicts.
status_legend.self_flagged_unverified: The originating report itself marks this as needing verification.
status_legend.stale: Older than the analysis date or outdated relative to the coverage window.
status_legend.limitation: Statement about data coverage or quality rather than a market fact.

cross_report_conflicts.detail: Fundamentals reports recommendation key none (F-72). Sentiment reports 1 strongBuy and 1 buy from yf rec_summary (S-02) and a Buy consensus (S-04). Both are yf cache. Needs a fresh pull.
Fundamentals 1.0582 (cache 11-23 17:58 UTC, F-04); market ta snapshot close 1.055 (M-04); market fast_info last_price 1.0501 (M-05). Differences are small and likely timing or source.
Fundamentals 50-day 1.81 and 200-day 2.71 (F-60) vs market MA50 1.789 and MA200 2.690 (M-11, M-12). Different sources or windows.

Fundamentals gives 224.9M shares at 6/30/26 (F-36). Holder percentages as of 9/30 imply a base near 191M (Susquehanna 2,696,839 / 1.41% = 191.3M; BNY Mellon 1,491,055 / 0.78% = 191.2M; S-10, S-11). News reports about 191M at YE25 (N-21) while fundamentals gives 193.0M (F-36). Holder percentages and the 6/30 count cannot both be on the same base without explanation.
Text in sec 2 says goodwill and intangibles rose from 0.3M to 42.1M in H1 2026 (F-75). Balance-sheet table shows YE24 0.0, YE25 26.6, 6/30/26 42.1 (F-35). Text and table do not match.

Fundamentals shows FY25 acquisition outflow of 10.5M, goodwill 26.6M at YE25 and 42.1M at 6/30/26, and attributes the H1 2026 increase to acquisitions (F-28, F-35, F-76). News says the Miraex acquisition was announced complete on 2026-11-17, after the 6/30 balance sheet, with a March 2026 LOI (N-07, N-08). Which deal drove which balance-sheet change is not resolved by either report.
Fundamentals: 6.2M shares, 2.9% of shares outstanding, down 36% from 9.7M (F-63). Sentiment: Benzinga about 5.8% to 5.9% of float around summer 2026 (S-33). Different dates and bases.

125M USD at about 4.11 per share is about 30.4M shares (N-16). News also cites up to 60.8M warrant shares at 5.50 (N-18). That is 2 warrants per share, which is not stated. Either the offering size, price or warrant ratio is wrong.

CoinCentral reports a 200M USD offering at about 7.65 per share, undated (N-22). This is above the 52-week high of 5.48 (M-08) and does not match the March 2026 offering (N-16). Likely a misattribution; treat as unverified.
